label: " the" and high-frequency function words
explanation: Fires on every occurrence of " the" (100% conditional rate; the overwhelming majority of strong firings) and, at much lower rates (15–30%), on other very frequent function tokens like " to", " and", " of", " a", ".", ",", "\n" — preceding prepositions predict firing only because they often precede "the". Strongest activations occur on " the" and on the first few tokens of sequences, especially review-style openings (Great/Good/Useful/Favorite…); ordinary content words and punctuation in code or lists stay silent, and the weak residual firing is diffuse noise.
